newsitem.title: CHILE: Enersis denies talks with Spain's Endesa.
newsitem.headline: Enersis denies talks with Spain's Endesa.

text.p: Enersis SA, the Chilean power investment company, on Thursday denied it was in negotiations with Spanish electric company Endesa to sell part of its stock portfolio.
"There are no negotiations between Endesa Espana and Enersis," said Enersis general manager Jose Yuraszeck.
Yuraszeck was asked about recent news reports that negotiations between the two companies were continuing, conflicting with reports from Madrid that Endesa had decided against buying part of Enersis.
The reports have affected share prices for Enersis and its investment units known as the Chispas group.
